Market today: Inflation fears are back, pushing the 10-year Treasury yield up. This is the real driver, and it's bad news for your concentrated tech/chip book, especially on margin.

Your holdings: SOXL (-54.51%) and SPAL (-33.52%) are still in the red and flagged for attention. QQQ (-0.84%) and SMH (-11.96%) are also flagged for trim. CRWD (16.12%) is your only green name.

Watch: Keep an eye on AMD. It's showing a strong setup on the scanner, and if it breaks out, it could be a signal for other chip names.

Bottom line: The rising yield environment is a major headwind for your portfolio. Focus on managing risk and protecting your capital.
plays: Consider trimming QQQ and SMH further given the market mood.
If AMD breaks its scanner entry (503.1-502.59) with conviction, it could be a short-term opportunity.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
